title: UAAP: La Salle women slip past Ateneo to secure Final 4 spot
summary: De La Salle University clinched a spot in the Final 4 of the UAAP Season 89 women's football tournament after a 1-0 win over Ateneo de Manila University on Saturday at the UP Diliman Football Stadium.
